title: JobHunterScore
description: One scored job posting. Seven rubric dimensions, extracted facts and short reasoning. The class letter is computed by the app and is never part of this object.

job_id.description: The job id from the input, copied unchanged.

scores.description: The seven rubric dimensions, each 0, 1 or 2, using the anchors in rubric.md.

niche.description: Niche match against the target roles in the profile, using the anchors in rubric.md.

level.description: Level, using the anchors in rubric.md.

stack.description: Stack match against the stack in the profile, using the anchors in rubric.md.

remote_timezone.description: Remote policy and timezone fit against the regions and hours the profile accepts, relocation included.

contract_form.description: Whether the posting allows the contract form the profile prefers.

comp_signal.description: Quality of the compensation signal in the posting, not the size of the amount.

company_signal.description: Company signal, using the anchors in rubric.md.

facts.description: Facts extracted from the posting text only. Unknown values stay unknown or null; never guess.

remote_policy.description: The remote policy stated in the posting.

employment_type.description: The engagement form the posting offers.

comp.description: Compensation exactly as stated in the posting, without conversion. All four fields are null when nothing is stated.

min.description: Lower bound as stated, otherwise null.

max.description: Upper bound as stated, otherwise null. A single stated figure goes in both min and max.

currency.description: Currency as stated, ISO 4217 code where the posting gives one, otherwise null.

period.description: The period the amount applies to, otherwise null.

timezone_note.description: One short sentence about required hours or overlap, an empty string when the posting says nothing.

requires_us_authorization.description: True only when United States work authorization must already be held; false when sponsorship or a visa is offered or authorization is not needed; null when the posting says nothing.

end_client_named.description: True when the actual employer is named, false when an agency hides it, null when it cannot be told.

ai_meaning.description: Short phrase on what AI concretely means in this role, an empty string when AI is not mentioned.

blocking_unknowns.description: Only the codes that apply. Empty array when none do.

reasoning.description: At most 60 words, English, plain sentences. Name the evidence that decided the score, including whatever is missing. No compensation figures, no class letter.
